Rationale: .select() on the customer update is load-bearing because a bare update reports no error when RLS matches zero rows
Rationale: mutate first then audit, so no log entry ever asserts a verification that did not land
Rationale: an accepted waiver reason is cleared when the customer changes so it is never recorded against the wrong person
Rationale: two DB CHECK constraints make a waiver impossible to store anonymously or unexplained, even for writes that bypass this form
Rationale: dates are stored with format() not toISOString() because toISOString shifted stored dates one day earlier for staff in UTC+ timezones
Rationale: the PAYG anchor is floored to creation time because a backdated start would make the catch-up loop post hundreds of accruals in 5-minute test mode
Rationale: pickup_time is re-checked three times because roughly 26% of recent non-PAYG portal rentals still landed with a NULL pickup_time
Rationale: the invoice records security_deposit as 0 to stop generate_first_charge_for_rental materialising an unpaid Security Deposit charge
Rationale: the insurance ledger charge uses rental.start_date so it collides with the unique charge index instead of duplicating the trigger-inserted Insurance row
Rationale: PAYG rentals skip the upfront invoice because apply-payment would retroactively materialise charges that collide with daily accruals
Rationale: auto-extend rentals skip weekend/holiday surcharges so a markup never rides into the stored monthly_amount the renewal cron bills every cycle
Rationale: the admin portal only enforces global blocked periods; vehicle-specific blocks are informational for staff
Rationale: the red 'cannot be created' message is downgraded to amber where the waiver is enabled, because the hard rule does not apply there
Rationale: an explicit 0 deposit override must leave the hold checkbox unticked; falling back to the tenant default attempted a deposit the operator opted out of
Rationale: individual fields are watched because form.watch() with no arguments returns a new object each render and causes an infinite loop
Rationale: rental_period_type is normalised for PAYG because the selector only displayed a coerced Weekly and the form still submitted Daily
Rationale: the whole coverage block is hidden rather than disabled in Bonzah test mode, because selling a sandbox policy charges for insurance that does not exist
Rationale: dates survive a vehicle swap instead of being wiped, because wiping also reset period type and amount when the operator was only comparing vehicles
Rationale: customers carries no verified_by/verified_at/notes column, so audit_logs IS the record of who manually verified and why
Rationale: a synchronous ref lock is needed because a double-click can fire twice before the loading state disables the submit button
Rationale: the pre-authorisation is shown below the headline total because it is a card hold released after return, matching the customer checkout view
Rationale: additional-driver creation and invites are non-fatal because the rental row is already committed and the tooling is independent of it
